summary: Consolidated Biscuit Co. Ltd is a biscuit and snack maker in Birkirkara, Malta, incorporated in 1980 and making snacks since 1986. Its Sunshine Snacks brand includes potato crisps and fried snacks made from potato pellets. Its major equity holder is Associated Brands Industries Ltd, based in the Caribbean.
ownership: Major equity holder Associated Brands Industries Ltd (ABIL), Caribbean
products: Potato crisps: Ready Salted, Cheese & Onion, Salt & Vinegar
Fried snacks made from potato pellets (Krips, Taytos, Blisters, Gobblers)
markets: Lebanon, Jordan, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Dubai and Bahrain (Devon products, via distributors)
Private label for the UK and Irish markets
facts: Snack food factory has 4 lines: a Florigo pellet frying line, two American Extrusion lines and a Cretor's popcorn line
Production began in 1982 under a licensing agreement with United Biscuits, which ended in 2002
Crisps Ready Salted: potatoes 68.2%, sunflower oil 30.6%, salt 1.2%; packs of 40g and 200g
Group has developed over 200 SKUs since 1974
